node.statement: Exact unconditional scope-and-sign bridge. The root does not quantify c_0^cb among the varying call data A,epsilon,m,w,j: it is one fixed scalar coefficient in the supplied inclusion predicate, so constants depending on its numerical value are still universal with respect to every quantified call datum. Put kappa:=abs(c_0^cb), which is finite and nonnegative because c_0^cb is a fixed scalar. The supplied P_j=w(e_j) entails m>=1. Write alpha:=c_0^cb*epsilon. If epsilon=0, then alpha=0. If epsilon>0, choose a nonzero x in C^m. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, w being an extended alpha-inclusion gives (1-alpha)||x|| <= ||w(x)|| <= (1+alpha)||x||; hence 1-alpha <= 1+alpha, so alpha>=0 and therefore c_0^cb>=0. Thus in every case 0<=alpha<=kappa*epsilon and alpha+epsilon<=(kappa+1)*epsilon. Choose the six external witnesses, enlarged where necessary to coefficient at least 1, and set K_1:=max{1,kappa,L,C_proj*L,C_np*L,C_pair*L,C_co*(kappa+1)} and e_call_1:=min{e_env,e_co/(kappa+1),e_proj/L,e_np/L,e_pair/L,e_1/K_1}. All denominators are positive, so e_call_1>0; K_1 is fixed, finite, universal and >=1; K_1*e_call_1<=e_1. For epsilon<=e_call_1, nodes 1.2-1.4 furnish every component with defect at most t_1:=K_1*epsilon<=e_1: the old compression uses alpha+epsilon<=(kappa+1)*epsilon, while all corner and producer coefficients are dominated by K_1. Form the complete raw-call record before inference exactly as in node 1.8, with candidate d_raw=D_1*t_1 for m>1 and the supplied fresh defect for m=1; recording d_raw is noncircular by def-maincb-raw-call. Applying lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement now gives the asserted output. No additional hypothesis on c_0^cb was inserted, and no external beyond the six shard dependencies was used.
